title: This bed is beautiful and sleek
text: This bed is beautiful and sleek. This bed is beautiful and sleek but do not purchase for a heavy adult.  It held up for awhile but after a couple months the poles under the mattress started breaking.  I'd say this bed must be more for a child or an adult under 200 pounds.

product_metadata.title: Modway Townhouse Modern Farmhouse Metal Twin Platform Bed in Black
features: MODERN FARMHOUSE TWIN BED - Graceful arches, delicate lines, lavish loops, and subtle spindle details adorn the integrated headboard and footboard of this charming country style platform bed
MATTRESS SUPPORT - An elegant addition to a toddler, guest or kid bedroom, the bed frame's metal slats offer quality mattress support. The slatted iron supports eliminate the need for a box spring
SUPERIOR CONSTRUCTION - Boasting an arching silhouette, the twin bed frame is solidly welded from iron and boasts a strong tubular design that provides lasting durability for years of peaceful sleep
PLATFORM BED - This modern classic comes with non-marking foot caps and supports mattress types such as memory foam and innerspring. This bed both anchors and elevates your guest or kid bedroom décor
BED MEASUREMENTS - The sleek black finish and delicate accents on this twin bed allow it to easily blend with any bedroom décor. Dimensions: 78.5"L x 39"W x 34"H; Maximum Weight Capacity: 660 lbs.
description: Historic appeal emerges from the fully welded construction and tubing of the Townhouse Bed Frame. The unique decorative banding adds a lighthearted rejoicing to the solidly linear rail design. Finished with a classic arc-shaped header and footer, gladden your room with this enamored piece of refuge.
